procedure — VLM GRADING CRITERIA
Assess the completed worksheet showing the ballast weight calculation and required ballast location visible in the image. Evaluate each criterion independently as PASS or FAIL.

Criteria
1. Aircraft total weight is written on the worksheet in kilograms
2. An out-of-range CG distance in inches is written as an addition of two CG values
3. A ballast location is written as a station or arm in centimeters
4. The ballast formula appears with weight divided by CG shift multiplied by distance from ballast location to limit
5. A final ballast weight answer is written in kilograms
6. The finished work shows this defect: Division and multiplication are transposed in the written formula.
7. The finished work shows this defect: The written arithmetic gives a result other than the shown numbers produce.
8. The finished work shows this defect: The final answer is blank or has no pounds unit.

Overall decision
Overall PASS requires every required criterion to pass and no critical defect. Mark an unobservable required criterion “FAIL — not demonstrated in image.” Evaluate only visible evidence and do not infer hidden measurements, internal damage, torque, pressure, or test results.
